title: IOD correction for the wind-only RMM, on top of the ENSO correction (enso_rmm_correction.json)
index: DMI (Saji et al. 1999), 50-70E 10S-10N minus 90-110E 10S-0, anomalies against 1991-2020. Fit: ERSST v6 monthly (data/reference/dmi_ersst6.csv) interpolated to daily between mid-months. Real time: NOAA OISST v2.1 daily (assets/sst/data/enso_daily.json), 31-day trailing mean.
fit: 2003-2024: slope of the observed wind-only RMM (rmm_era5.nc) minus dN34 * c (c as applied) on dDMI, the DMI minus its mean over the 120 days ending on the day, over June-December (dDMI 0 in January-May)
apply: RMM_clean = RMM_wind - dN34 * c - dDMI * d in June-December, dDMI = the DMI at the day (forecasts: at the init, held through the forecast) minus its mean over the 120 days of the wind filter window

bootstrap.method: 2000 resamples of whole years (22), slope refitted

validation.index: the observed wind-only RMM (rmm_era5.nc) with the ENSO correction as applied (dN34 * c), without and with the IOD term; dDMI from the ERSST v6 DMI, dN34 from ERSST v6 Nino-3.4, each minus its mean over the 120 days ending on the day
